title: The Last Bakery
author: Xanthe Hartwell
blurb: Orsen Amberdale, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
